name: qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin_mu

pin_regs.reason: Explicit source captures every active functional input once; actual qkd_d2d_cal_seq output FFs are the output pin FFs. Local epoch capture compensated by raw EP_SKEW-1. No generic extra stage permitted. Source exact72-layer two-token proof plus failing anchor mutant; AUTO tok_go is internally0 and no physical input remains.

job.purpose: KV-side MU d2d calendar sequencer (MU-DIE-KV2 / KV-DCAL-MU 10-19): qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin built from ot_qwen_d2d_cal_seq_dies_mu.sv + d2d_cal_image_mu.svh (D2D_MU=1 d2d_cal_image_production.sh on the MU release pair seam 2,2,2,3,2,2/11,11,9,9,9,9,9: TXDP_C 0x0a010308, TXDP_K 0x03030415 [21,4,3,3] = production d2d_cal_image.svh; MU context slot = +1 K TX / C RX entry, SEG2 8->9). Same ports/outline/pins as _ep3 (die slot DCAL_WH 18.792x28.08); replaces the ep3 labelled stand-in when OT_KV_MU=1. Static calendar, no credits/backpressure; reset landing 2 stages (boot constant).

benches.name: mu_compiled_timeline_and_exception_deadlines

structural_change: Copy of the CLOSED _ep3 kit (TT/FF closed 10-16, synth 156 um2, 45% std util in 18.792x28.08) with the MU calendar image: one more K TX image word (constant), SEG2 9; no RTL structure, pin, outline or cycle change. Recipe 3 kept; reset_landing 2 stages added (ROOT-RST 10-19); io_hold_margin 0.03.
